options: She has already finished her homework.
She already has finished her homework.
She has finished already her homework.
She already finished has her homework.
answers: She has already finished her homework.
questions.explanation: already 应放在 have/has 之后、过去分词之前，因此第一句正确。
questions.evidence: I already know fifty new words.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I have not finished my project ______.
options: yet
already
since
for
questions.explanation: 否定句句末表示“还（没）”用 yet。
questions.evidence: I have not finished my flashcard set yet.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We have lived here ______ 2019.
options: since
for
yet
already
questions.explanation: since 后接时间点（2019），表示“自从”。
questions.evidence: I have used flashcards since the first week.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: They have studied English ______ three years.
options: for
since
yet
already
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段（three years），表示持续多久。
questions.evidence: But I have studied with a partner for two weeks, and that helps me more.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the past only.
options: I started the course last week.
I have started the course last week.
I have start the course last week.
I has started the course last week.
answers: I started the course last week.
questions.explanation: last week 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时 started，不用现在完成时。
questions.evidence: I started late, so my numbers are low.

options: He has just eaten lunch.
He just has eaten lunch.
He has eaten just lunch.
He just eaten has lunch.
questions.explanation: just 与 already 类似，放在 have/has 之后、过去分词之前。
questions.evidence: I already know fifty new words.

options: Have you finished the test yet?
You have finished the test yet?
Have finished you the test yet?
Do you have finished the test yet?
answers: Have you finished the test yet?
questions.explanation: 现在完成时的一般疑问句把 have/has 提前，yet 放句末。
questions.evidence: They have not started this new test yet.

options: We have known each other for five years.
We have knew each other for five years.
We know each other since five years.
We have known each other since five years.
answers: We have known each other for five years.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时用过去分词 known；for 后接时间段 five years。
questions.evidence: But I have studied with a partner for two weeks, and that helps me more.

title: Checking the Evidence: A Study Group Talks About Flashcards · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
现在完成时表示“到现在为止已经发生或完成的事”，结构是 have/has + 过去分词。它常和 already（已经，用于肯定句）、yet（还，用于否定句和疑问句）、since（自从，后接时间点）、for（持续，后接时间段）连用。一般过去时只说明过去某个时间发生的事，不强调与现在的联系。例如：I have used flashcards since the first week.（从第一周到现在一直在用） vs. I started late.（过去开始得晚，只讲过去）。注意：already 通常放在 have/has 之后、过去分词之前；yet 通常放在句末。

I have used flashcards since the first week.
